name: Claude API
summary: Anthropic's API lets your app call Claude models to generate text, reason through tasks, and power AI features.

free_plan_covers.note: No guaranteed ongoing free allowance; Anthropic's own support docs say new Console accounts are not guaranteed automatic free credit.

first_paid_usd_month.note: No flat monthly plan for the API; it is pay-as-you-go per token.

portability.note: Proprietary Messages API with its own message and content-block format, different from other providers' shapes.

free_tier.note: No ongoing free rate-limited tier is documented; some new accounts may see limited promotional credit, but it is not guaranteed.

sdk_typescript.note: Official TypeScript/JavaScript SDK is published as the "@anthropic-ai/sdk" npm package.

cheap_model_price.value: Claude Haiku 4.5: $1 input / $5 output per million tokens
cheap_model_price.note: Cheapest current model; described by Anthropic as its fastest, most cost-efficient option.

setup.step: Create a Claude Console account at platform.claude.com.
Create an API key from Console settings.
Set the key as an environment variable.
Install the SDK with npm install @anthropic-ai/sdk.
Import Anthropic and call client.messages.create from a server-side route handler.

builder_notes: Keep ANTHROPIC_API_KEY on the server only; never call the Messages API from client-side code.
Use a smaller model like Haiku for high-volume or low-stakes tasks to control cost.
Add a payment method before building; there is no guaranteed ongoing free tier to prototype against.
